data.name: True Galactic Mission
data.detailed_description:
TRUE GALACTIC MISSION:

There are 5 pilots in training, each with peculiar characteristics. It's the day of the final test and everyone will face a obstacle to see who will be able to accept the next challenge, a true galactic mission.

Be one of the pilots chosen for this mission and embark on infinite space in search of the unknown, in order to discover what is altering the flow of the universe!

TRUE GALACTIC MISSION is a vertical Shoot 'Em Up in the style of 90s arcade games. Originally developed for the Mega Drive console, the game takes place across 9 levels with futuristic backgrounds where you must face and shoot various spacecraft, ending by confronting a boss at the end of each stage. You can acquire power-ups that can enhance your shots, increase your speed, equip bombs, or become invincible with a force shield.

MAIN FEATURES:

• Classic & Intense Arcade Gameplay: Precise controls and frantic action in the best "dodge-and-shoot" style. Each stage is a new wave of challenges designed to test your skills.

• Choose Your Pilot: Each of the 5 pilots has a ship with unique characteristics, slightly affecting gameplay. Choose the one that best fits your style!

• Nine Challenging Stages: Travel through futuristic and diverse environments, from the Blue Galaxy to the stormy Meteor Rain, from the dark Shadow Valley to the menacing Tech City, and the core of danger, the Main Brain.

• Strategic Power-Up System: Collect capsules to upgrade your weaponry (from a simple shot to powerful level 5), gain invincibility shields, increase speed, restore energy, or stock devastating bombs (up to 9!).

• Epic Boss Fights: At the end of each stage, a unique and challenging boss awaits, requiring memorized attack patterns and dodges to defeat.

• True to the 16-bit Spirit: Graphics, soundtrack, and sound effects that capture the essence of the Mega Drive/Genesis, offering a nostalgic and authentic experience.

• Progression and Replayability: Try to beat your high score, master all the ships, and complete the mission on the difficulty level you dare to choose.

ABOUT THE GAMEPLAY:

Take control of a combat ship on a vertical journey. Your goal is simple: survive and advance. Eliminate waves of enemy ships, dodge a hail of projectiles, and use power-ups wisely to strengthen yourself. The energy bar allows you to take a few hits, but the action is relentless. With each completed stage, the difficulty increases, leading to a final battle against a gigantic boss. Get ready for a mission that will test your reflexes and courage. The universe needs a hero. Will it be you?

TAKE CONTROL!

Start Button

• Press during the Title screen to go to the Menu screen.

• Press during the Menu screen to go to the Start, Options or Credits screen.

• Press on the Start screen to go to the Pilot Selection screen.

• Press on the Options screen to confirm the selected options and return to the Menu screen.

• Press on the Credits screen to restart the cartridge.

• Press on the Pilot Selection screen to confirm the selected character and ship.

• Press to pause gameplay, then press again to exit the paused state.

• Press at the Game Over screen to reset the cartridge. D-Button

• On the Menu screen, press up or down to select Start, Options, or Credits.

• On the Options screen, press up or down to highlight your choice. Then press left or right to change chosen option.

• On the Pilot Selection screen, press left or right to change the chosen pilot and ship.

• Press right or left to move your aircraft sideways.

• Press up or down to move your aircraft forward or backward.

Button A

• Press to fire with Shooting Mode 1. This shooting type upgrade like Mode 2.

Button B

• Press to fire with Shooting Mode 2. This shooting type upgrade like Mode 1.

Button C

• Press to shot a bomb, if you have one.

SCREEN SIGNALS:

The main screen, where the game takes place, is full of graphic icons that have special meaning in our challenge. Below we can see a diagram of the usefulness of these items.

• Pilot Photo: Photo of the pilot chosen to be the player.

• Score: Points acquired by the player during the game.

• Mission Number: Number of the current game phase. There are 9 phases in total.

• Energy Bar: Amount of energy the player has per life.

• Number of Lives: Number of lives the player still has left.

• Number of Bombs: Number of bombs the player still has left. The maximum the player can have is 9 bombs.

• Weapon Level: Amount of bullets the player's ship can fire at once. The maximum armament level is 5.

• Player's Ship: Ship you control during the game.

• Enemies: Enemies you face during the game.

• Power Up: Power capsule capable of granting some advantages in the game. It can be Armament, Life, Energy, Speed ​​or Defense Shield. You need to touch your ship with the Power Up capsule to absorb its power. The capsules can be:

Weapons: Increases the weapon level. Maximum weapon level is 5.

Energy: Slightly increases the spaceship's energy level.

Speed: Increases the spaceship's speed. Maximum speed level is 6.

Bombs: Receives 2 extra bombs to destroy enemies. Maximum number of bombs is 9.

Life: Receives 1 extra life. When you lose all your lives, the game ends.

Shield: Receives a protective shield against enemy shots. Touching enemies can destroy the shield. When you level up, you loose the shield.

GAME LEVELS:

The game has a total of 9 scenarios, all with a main boss. You will have to go through the Blue Galaxy and then cross the Meteor Shower to reach the Valley of Shadows. After passing the Technological City you will see the Surface of Galabertron and discover how to reach the Main Brain in order to finish your first big mission. These are the locations you will have to go through to complete your mission:
